name: drawsvg
role: Python library for generating editable SVG drawings and animations
notes: 2026-11-15: Triage: assess; Python-authored SVG frames provide a distinct language route to existing vector renderers. Revisit after checking seekable animation and resvg compatibility in a fixture.
2026-11-15: Skill opportunity: existing VCR SVG guidance covers the vector workflow; revisit a drawsvg-specific guide only if a repeated Python animation route needs operating details.
summary: Python library builds SVG drawings and frame-based or SVG-native animations from code, with Jupyter display support. The vector-first output stays editable and can be rasterised separately; optional raster and video export paths add dependencies.
use_when: Generate editable SVG diagrams or title artwork from Python data
Build SVG or frame-based animation while keeping vector source
Use a Python-native alternative to assembling SVG strings manually
avoid_when: Use SVG CLI tools for a static logo conversion or optimization task
Use Anime.js or browser capture for DOM-rich motion with browser layout and typography

assessment.rationale: The maintained project moved from GitHub to Tangled and tags 2.4.2; PyPI documents Python SVG drawing and animation, with raster formats requiring optional support. MIT terms are reported by the package metadata; exact current licence text should be reconfirmed before redistribution.
